title: SOUND x FLOW Quantitative Compute Bridge Input Contract
description: Domain-free declarative arithmetic, vector conservation, bounded recurrence, linear solve, and predicate AST specification executed deterministically outside the language model.
system_instructions: Do NOT perform arithmetic, rounding, multi-step recurrence, or algebraic solving inline in tokens.
Emit a compact JSON compute specification under this schema instead.
Bind known quantities in 'vars' using integer, exact decimal strings (e.g. '0.05'), rational strings ('9/12'), 1D arrays of numbers, or null when missing/unknown.

Build intermediate values in 'exprs' with operators: add, sub, mul, div, neg, abs, min, max, pow_int, if_else, sum, dot, get, pro_rata, recur_fold, round_half_up, round_half_even, floor, ceil, solve_linear.
Attach 'guards' mapping an expression name to a SoundArena node label when execution must be gated by normative node establishment.
Express boolean facts or conservation checks in 'predicates' using: eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, approx_eq, in_range, sum_eq, and, or, not.
